discussion_comments.comment_body: Valid, fixed in 79b8bcabc. The quit handler now calls `stopImmediatePropagation()` on a matched keydown, same as the page-level shortcuts, so the chat input never sees it. Added a test that a quit keydown on a textarea never reaches its handler.
[P2] In a saved conversation, acknowledging an optimistic prompt or replacing “Thinking…” with output can jump the transcript back to its first prompt, losing the reader’s position.

Fixed in 2ca3f16b8 (the @shadcn/react patch) and now covered by a desktop-level regression test in b97435245: history hydrates after the provider mounts on the loading row, a new prompt pins near the top, then the Thinking row is swapped for the first answer row in one commit and the viewport must stay on the new prompt. The test fails on the unpatched dist (scrollTop jumps to 0) and passes with the patch. Also verified in the Tauri app on a saved 5-prompt session: no jump at first token or at completion.
